from pathlib import Path
import textwrap, collections
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace')
p=base/'programs'/'task-4bf4f21e.py'
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import deque, Counter\n\ndef transform(grid):\n    g=[row[:] for row in grid]\n    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])\n    bg=Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]\n    seen=set(); q=deque()\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in (0,w-1):\n            if g[r][c]==bg and (r,c) not in seen:\n                seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))\n    for c in range(w):\n        for r in (0,h-1):\n            if g[r][c]==bg and (r,c) not in seen:\n                seen.add((r,c)); q.append((r,c))\n    while q:\n        r,c=q.popleft()\n        for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):\n            if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and g[nr][nc]==bg and (nr,nc) not in seen:\n                seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))\n    for r in range(h):\n        for c in range(w):\n            if g[r][c]==bg and (r,c) not in seen:\n                g[r][c]=4\n    return g\n'''
p.write_text(source)
# demo pair grid
D=[[0,0,5]+[0]*12 for _ in range(10)]
# rows 0-5 pattern at c2 5
for r in range(6): D[r][2]=5
D[6][1:4]=[5,5,5]
D[7][1:4]=[5,0,5]
D[8][1:4]=[5,0,5]
D[9]=[5]*15; D[9][2]=0
D[10][1:4]=[5,5,5]; D[10][11]=5
for r in range(11,22): D[r][11]=5
O=[row[:] for row in D]
for r in [7,8,9]: O[r][2]=4
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
print('demo reproduce:',mod.transform(D)==O)
T=[[5]*15 for _ in range(17)]
for r in [0,1]: T[r][3]=0
T[2]=[0]*15
for r in (8,12):
    for c in (9,10,11): T[r][c]=0
for r in (9,11):
    T[r][9]=T[r][11]=0
T[10]=[0]*15; T[10][10]=5
for r in range(13,17): T[r][10]=0
ans=mod.transform(T)
print('test output:')
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in ans))
